<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/mcr/templateVariation"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Accepts template image as file upload and template data as JSON string in multipart form.
When batchSize is provided, creates multiple tasks per image (e.g., batchSize=2 creates 2 tasks with the same job_id but different task_ids).

This is an asynchronous operation that returns a job_id. Use the `/aivision/jobs/:job_id` endpoint to check the status and retrieve results.
